activity_summary: You stood by a post on the left. The board gave the title only. A tall boy with a staff, in a buff jerkin and breeches, faced three Spanish swaggerers, and the yard roared. Alleyn was easy in a smaller part. Henslowe at the door counted with his lips and did not show the count. You were looking at the yard more than at the stage.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood by the post on the left and followed the yard.

entities.name: Edward Alleyn
entities.context: Played, easy, in a part smaller than himself.

entities.name: Philip Henslowe
entities.context: Counted heads at the door with his lips, and did not show the figure.

entities.name: Long Meg of Westminster
entities.context: Mentioned in A post on the left

facets.activity: Stood by the post and looked at the yard
